# GoodTherapy

> GoodTherapy is a comprehensive therapist directory and mental health platform connecting clients with licensed therapists while offering continuing education, resources, and professional development for mental health practitioners.

GoodTherapy serves both clients seeking therapy and licensed mental health professionals across the US, Canada, and internationally. The platform combines a robust therapist matching service with educational content, CE credits, and practice-building tools for counselors and therapists.

## Key Topics

- Therapist Directory
- Find Therapist
- Mental Health Education
- Continuing Education Credits
- Therapy Matching
- Counselor Search
- Mental Health Resources
- Professional Development
- Licensed Therapists
- LCSW, MFT, PsyD
- US & Canada Coverage
- Mental Health Services
- Therapy Practice Growth
- BIPOC Mental Health
- Grief & Resilience

## Find a Therapist

- [GoodTherapy.org - Find the Right Therapist](https://www.goodtherapy.org/next/find-therapist): Therapist finder with location-based search across US and Canada
- [GoodTherapy.org - Find the Right Therapist](https://www.goodtherapy.org/next): Main therapist finder and directory with therapy matching services
- [Browse GoodTherapy.org for Therapists by State](https://www.goodtherapy.org/therapists/united-states): State-by-state therapist directory for United States counselor search
- [Counselors & Therapists in Top US Cities](https://www.goodtherapy.org/therapists/united-states/top-cities): Browse therapists by top US cities for location-based counselor search
- [International Search](https://www.goodtherapy.org/find-therapy/international-search.html): International therapist search outside US and Canada

## For Mental Health Professionals

- [Join GoodTherapy Today: Get More Clients & Grow Your Practice](https://www.goodtherapy.org/join-therapist-directory-membership.html): Therapist membership signup to grow practice and get client referrals
- [Continuing Education for Counselors](https://www.goodtherapy.org/continuing-education-for-counselors.html): Continuing education platform offering CE credits and webinars
- [GoodTherapy | How Mental Health Professionals Can Earn CE...](https://www.goodtherapy.org/blog/ce-credits-mental-health-professionals): Guide on earning continuing education credits for therapists
- [Managing Expectations of Grief Process](https://www.goodtherapy.org/how-long-will-this-take-managing-expectations-of-grief-process-web-conference.html): 2-hour CE webinar on grief management expectations for therapists
- [Unveiling Shame: Nurturing Resilience and Agency](https://www.goodtherapy.org/unveiling-shame-nurturing-resilience-and-agency-web-conference.html): 2-hour CE webinar on shame and resilience for mental health professionals
